design: exploratory post hoc sample, not preregistered experiment
scope: 20-case stratified-by-model/prompt exploratory sample; not the full 1680 reports

vanilla.denominator: agree / (agree + disagree + mixed); excludes not_comparable, no_conclusion and unresolved; these counts are reported, never treated as disagreement.

obligation.denominator: agree / (agree + disagree + mixed); excludes not_comparable, no_conclusion and unresolved; these counts are reported, never treated as disagreement.

all.denominator: agree / (agree + disagree + mixed); excludes not_comparable, no_conclusion and unresolved; these counts are reported, never treated as disagreement.

technical_retry: At most two attempts. Initial max_tokens=2048; technical retry budget increased to 4096; no valid judgment selectively rerun.
excluded_v1: Initial 772-record partial/salvaged-JSON audit discarded; retained in original QA ledger, not pooled.

missing_label_bounds.scope: sampled inquiries consistently classified as committee-reference; conditional on that unvalidated source classification

legacy_call_accounting: 772 retained legacy result records are not complete API-call accounting; earlier pilot failures were not all preserved.
interpretation: Automated exploratory classification, not human-calibrated and not a full-population agreement estimate. Within-case source-kind inconsistencies, if present, are listed explicitly; absence of inconsistency is not source validation. The result cannot establish which evidence is inconvenient for an agent.
